seo.title: TPA Job File Audit for Restoration Companies | deltaV
seo.description: Check restoration job files against each TPA program's guidelines before you submit. Missing photos, signatures and logs are flagged with the page behind them.
faq: Does it submit files to the TPA?
No. It checks the file before you submit. Your team still sends it through the program's portal.
Each program's guidelines are set up as a checklist during scoping, so it follows the rules your programs actually use.
What about homeowner data and photos?
Data handling is agreed during scoping and the system runs where your compliance requires.
